records.question: 美国有多少客户？
records.actual_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA';

records.question: 每个国家分别有多少客户？
records.actual_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(CustomerId) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country;

records.question: 所有发票的总金额是多少？
records.actual_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice;

records.question: 发票的平均金额是多少？
records.actual_sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice;

records.question: 金额最高的一张发票是多少？
records.actual_sql: SELECT MAX(Total) FROM Invoice;

records.question: 2023年开了多少张发票？
records.actual_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate LIKE '2023%';

records.question: 姓Smith的客户有多少？
records.actual_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE LastName = 'Smith';

records.question: 哪个歌手的专辑最多？
records.actual_sql: SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(Album.AlbumId) DESC LIMIT 1;

records.question: 哪种音乐类型的歌曲最多？
records.actual_sql: SELECT Genre.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId GROUP BY Track.GenreId ORDER BY COUNT(Track.TrackId) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: 消费总额最高的前5个客户是谁？
records.actual_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 5;

records.question: 单首歌曲的最高销量是多少？
records.actual_sql: SELECT MAX(total) FROM (SELECT SUM(Quantity) AS total FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY TrackId);
